newsitem.title: HONG KONG: SHK Props to build HK movie park - paper.
newsitem.headline: SHK Props to build HK movie park - paper.

text.p: Hong Kong developer Sun Hung Kai Properties Ltd has signed a letter of intent with film giant Golden Harvest Entertainment Holdings Ltd to build a movie theme park, the Sunday Morning Post reported.

Sited on Ma Wan Island near Hong Kong's new airport, plans envisage the park would include a stage set to enable visitors to watch films being made and a museum featuring the history of the territory's film industry, the newspaper said.
Details have yet to be finalised.
The project would be part of a larger HK$8.5 billion 42-tower block residential housing resort planned by the same developer, it said.
Officials from the two companies were not immediately available for comment. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 28436441
